notes: Complete free-Lie/Lazard proof; marked-letter substitutions are injective by least left-word length, eliminating cancellation.

notes: Nonzero metabelian arithmetic derivations exist at every prime; CM Frobenius projectors extract one weight. This is a full pro-ell assertion, not only finite-class fixed layers.

notes: The sole nonzero b0 is sufficient: T(x) is not in [x,L4]. Class4 logarithmic denominators are units at5.

notes: The degree2 first term forces the power character to be exactly cyclotomic, including on the geometric kernel.

statement: The actual rational arithmetic (3,3) line in degree6 is spanned by V6=([F,[F,epsilon6]]-192Z3)/6; its coefficient is chi3/1536. The full degree6 rational embedding is explicit.
depends_on: HainMatsumoto2020, sections6-7 and20-22, Proposition29.1 and Corollary29.2
notes: The universal constant mixed Tate quotient identifies the invariant coefficient at every smooth fibre; the geometric coefficient is computed separately from the corrected raw theta character. W and relative M are distinguished: both the W-degree4 Tate component and W-degree6 invariant component come from the same one-dimensional M-weight6 source; only the quotient coefficient is transported. Exact boundary, SL2, metabelian, Pollack-tree and defining-Tate-equation checks pass. No integral image index is claimed.

statement: Exact embedded generator coordinates beyond degree6 and their integral arithmetic indices are not all determined. The degree8 middle line is reduced to one unique unknown scalar lambda in A8+lambda B8.
depends_on: Malkin2020CM, Section2.2.3 and Theorems11,15--16 (attempted conditional route only)
notes: G.21 resolves the degree6 (3,3) line. In degree8, A8=F^3 epsilon8/120 and B8=[epsilon4,F^2 epsilon4]/2 give the exact family; the coefficient is d^3 chi4^(4)/267840. Boundary, CM/conjugation symmetry, metabelian coefficients, universal geometric membership and every verified rank through14 are independent of lambda. The exact Tate term Sigma3[8]=[epsilon4,F epsilon4]/480 has M-weight minus6 and zero constant quotient, so it does not supply the CM weight4 coefficient. Its defining lift is checked through length9. Imposing the Tate N-commutation on A8+lambda B8 would exclude every lambda, as F(A8),F(B8) have rank2. The local Coleman-Ihara formula has scalar minus6048 at (4,4) in its own normalization and still factors through the metabelian character, so it cannot detect B8 or determine lambda. Its integral use additionally needs a Coates-Wiles image lattice and the Johnson-subgroup comparison. Actual CM specialization and higher placement remain unknown. G.23 strengthens the algebraic nonuniqueness to all orders: every A8+lambda B8 exponentiates in the universal elliptic kernel and survives prescribed exact finite CM-lift transport. G.24 proves the saturated ambient plane lattice Z5*(A8+(31/20)B8)+Z5*B8 and gives integral finite Magnus coordinates alpha=-[x^5y^4]D(x), nu=[x^4yxy^3]D(x)+4[x^5y^4]D(x). Actual-word ambient tests modulo125 give (1,0) and (1,1), but the actual arithmetic nu and the arithmetic image lattice remain uncomputed. The depth-two Hodge/Bianchi source Malkin2020 explicitly conditions its etale transfer and uses an averaged-basepoint torsion-punctured setting; it does not supply the missing arithmetic value.

statement: For the specified tangent abelian class-field factorization holds exactly at N1,N2; first failure at N3 is kappa_(1+i) ad(omega), cutting out K^ab((1+i)^(1/5^infty)).
notes: For the cancelling packet first failure is N5, and its conductor-four cyclotomic-unit Kummer field is also explicitly given.

statement: In the full profinite group, one nonzero maximal-pro-ell image suffices to recognize a procyclic subgroup with open arithmetic normalizer as peripheral.
notes: First recognize the actual ell-component via Nakamura, then use its full peripheral centralizer to control every other component; no full-character leap.

statement: Full profinite fixed subgroups and undetected procyclic normalizers remain undecided; their precise residual cases lie in the common kernel of all maximal pro-ell quotients.
notes: Finite-cover detectors and recognition hypotheses are checked. G.22 places a residual proper-homology vector in the Prym kernel, excludes genus-one compactifications, and proves the conditional punctured-target transport. The unresolved step is eliminating the relevant fixed or weight-one CM Prym component, or constructing a detecting map with an entire fibre in the boundary and a proved normalizer theorem for that exact target. Automatic puncturing and normalizer-preserving lifts across filling maps fail in explicit examples.
